    The prototype gets a cleaner assembly, the OS gets swapped out for DietPi, and the first GPIO script runs.
  • Mar 4, 2026
    Wiring It All Together
    A ribbon cable, a power board, a breadboard full of sensors and LEDs, and the first real data flowing through the pipeline.

    Setup Docker on the Pi, the MING stack comes up for the first time, and a GPIO test board gets designed.
